Platform Engineering · Kubernetes · Cloud Native

About me

I'm Piero Rospigliosi, a Senior Platform Engineer with more than 10 years of experience across software engineering, cloud architecture and Kubernetes platforms. I build secure, scalable and reusable infrastructure that helps engineering teams deliver software with less operational friction.

Platform architecture

Designing and modernizing Kubernetes platforms on AWS and GCP with clear boundaries, reusable patterns and production-grade operations.

GitOps & automation

Automating infrastructure and application delivery with Terraform, Crossplane, Helm, Kustomize, Flux, Argo CD and GitHub Actions.

Observability & reliability

Building monitoring, logging and tracing platforms with Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Datadog, Loki, Mimir and OpenTelemetry.

Security & networking

Applying least privilege, IAM, OIDC, TLS, Kyverno, Cilium and modern Gateway API patterns across cloud-native environments.
